title: onboard-polaris-pro-20b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add Polaris Pro 20B v1.0 to model registry with metadata, performance profiles and automated changelog integration. Recommended quantization profiles and perf numbers included; no breaking API changes.
body: Summary: Onboard Polaris Pro 20B v1.0 into the model registry. This PR adds model metadata, curated performance profiles (latency/throughput targets and recommended batch/kv-cache configs), unit test harness updates for automated benchmarking, and hooks for changelog/release note automation so new model metadata appears in release notes with minimal manual work. Motivation: Polaris Pro 20B is a partner model we want available in the hosted catalog and private deployments. We validated perf on p4d and a100 and captured profiles for common sequence length buckets. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata (name, architecture, tokenizer, licenses) - [x] Add perf profiles for 512/1024 token targets - [x] Add quantization recommendations (int8/4-bit profile ids) - [x] Add automated changelog entry template + generator integration - [x] Add perf unit tests and CI job - [x] Validate schema and linting - [x] Docs snippet for model details Notes: - Perf numbers are median of 5 runs; see perf files for full stats. - License checked with legal (partner-approved permissive license). - No changes to API surface. Rollout plan: 1) merge to main, 2) enable model in staging catalog for 48h smoke tests, 3) enable in hosted catalog with monitored canary routing.

Add quantization recommendations and alias mappings (Maya Chen)
perf: add benchmark harness and CI job for Polaris Pro (Maya Chen)

patch_snippets: + changelog-generator: detect models/*/metadata.json and create release fragment
review_comments: Ravi Patel (reviewer): Can you confirm the p99 numbers and the hardware used? The p99 looks optimistic for 1024 tokens on p4d.
Maya Chen (author): Numbers were captured on a4x (8xA100) and p4d for comparison. Updated the perf file to include per-hardware breakdown and increased p99 for 1024 to better reflect tail latency.
Liam O'Connor (reviewer): Please add an alias mapping so older code referencing 'polaris-20b' doesn't break. Also, add a short docs snippet into models/README.
Maya Chen (author): Added alias mapping and docs snippet in latest commit. Also added schema validation step to CI to catch metadata issues.
Sofia Alvarez (approver): Verified perf test passes in CI and sanity-checked the license. Approving.
merge_details: Squash-merged after approvals; changelog-generator picked up new metadata and created a release fragment in /changelogs/auto/2024-11-12-polaris-pro-20b.md
notes_for_release_engineer: Enable staging routing for polaris-pro-20b for 48 hours and monitor token-level latency dashboards. If p99 tail > target for 1024 seq, rollback to canary routing.
